items.name: Nanobot Suit
items.effect: Auto-success on a VIG Challenge Roll.

items.name: Data Shard
items.effect: Auto-success on a MIN or TEC Challenge Roll.

items.name: TruZite Tablet
items.effect: +1 to all stats until next cycle.

items.name: Signature Matrix
items.effect: Success -> +1d6 to any roll until next cycle.

items.name: NuScan
items.effect: Unlock 3 slots in the Cyberspace Memory Clock.

items.name: Zero Clapper
items.effect: Gain an extra Ride action next turn.

items.name: Frag Grenade
items.effect: Success vs highest-difficulty enemy -> all enemies Silenced for TEC turns.

items.name: EMP Grenade
items.effect: Success vs highest-difficulty enemy -> all enemies Silenced for TEC turns.

items.name: Heat Bomb
items.effect: Success vs highest-difficulty enemy -> all enemies Stunned for TEC turns.

items.name: Tear Shell
items.effect: Success vs highest-difficulty enemy -> all enemies Blinded for TEC turns.

items.name: Flash Bomb
items.effect: Success vs highest-difficulty enemy -> all enemies Beaconed for TEC turns.

items.name: Warp Drive
items.effect: Teleport to any tile for 6 Fuel. Must be in the Cargo Hold.

items.name: Trading License
items.effect: Sell exclusive items in ISF Settlements (except Narcobiotics). +10 scraps on sale.

items.name: Tesseract
items.effect: Restore 3+ (Energy/Hyperdrive) for each Cybertech implant equipped.

items.name: Contraband Package
items.effect: Illegal cargo. Sells only at Syndicate Settlements for 100 scraps. Lost if ship destroyed in space combat.

items.name: NGHTMR Key
items.effect: Breach an enemy for 5 turns OR force an enemy ship to skip its turn.

items.name: Tricillin Tablet
items.effect: +1 to all stats until next cycle.

items.name: Supranova Physic
items.effect: +2 to a stat of choice until next cycle.

overdose.rule: Consuming more than one narcobiotic per cycle = OVERDOSE. Each additional use while in Overdose increases the stage by 1. Negative effects are permanent until resting at a Settlement.
